**1.021: Paste last only pastes what was missed, and Corn on the start-up screen.**

- **Paste last:** after an early Enter kept your last words out of a message, the Paste last key and tray item now paste only those words, not the whole take again.
- **Licensing:** Hebrish now tells you once, when you first open it, how it is licensed, with the Creative Commons icons. About has the same text, and the wording matches [hebrish.app/licensing](https://hebrish.app/licensing).
- **Corn the Sloth**, the mascot, is on the start-up screen.
- The tray menu shows the running version.
- Beta: Ubuntu 26.04 .deb. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
